purpose: Execute the user-approved order: coupled controls, then halving/carry, then format/address validation
source: Unchanged nominal256 states, full physical scales and all residual bits preserved

C28.phase_binding: C18 staircase zero phases; r=z-1; this is a tested hypothesis, not established author intent
C28.marker_binding: C7 measured BD bits, used as candidate per-block polarity or neighbor direction
C28.flag: g=local_Lr XOR selected_R_control XOR optional_marker_bit XOR global_polarity
C28.decode: D'=neighbor(D) XOR g, F'=1-g; inverse must restore every original state using unchanged R
C28.neighbor_cycles: Within-block8 cells or whole64 cells; marker-directed shifts are constant within each block and therefore bijections
C28.baselines: One identity case per frame; no per-cell tuned parameter
C28.internal_diagnostic: Complement checks at cell neighbors, neighboring blocks and lag2 blocks, including the middle region; report exact fractions without treating best score as a p-value
C28.positive_control: Same generic flag primitive must reproduce all51 Level2 output characters

C29.byte_terms: 64 bytes as16*decoded_main+R or16*R+decoded_main; both are explicit hypotheses
C29.pairing: Adjacent terms only; one resulting byte per pair as Level5 composition control
C29.segment_cut_definition: Carry flows from less to more significant bytes; marker cut between blocks b and b+1 uses marker[b], b0..6; final marker bit does not define an extra boundary
C29.geometry: From decoded_main+R reconstruct a transformed q; exact q/2 piecewise-linear radius area in64 cells at anchor92, normalized or measured physical node scales; round_each_then_sum or sum_then_round
C29.calibration: Baseline area vectors must equal archived C16 exact rational profiles; verify word-level arithmetic with independently computed integers
C29.loss_statement: Pair sums, averages and word truncations are many-to-one; retain original full inputs, final carries, remainders and deterministic recipes; do not claim these are invertible renderers

C30.raw_key_views: Forward/reversed bytes and bit reversal within each byte; no arbitrary nibble permutation sweep
C30.wif_source: Two lossless352bit layouts: main32+outer_residual12, or blockwise main/residual interleaving in edges with middle residual zeros implicit
C30.wif_views: Both whole-stream bit directions, padding offsets0/1/2 and MSB/LSB per7bit character; exactly50 characters, require full Base58 alphabet before prepending5 and Base58Check
C30.hex_source: Only a complete64byte ASCII-hex stream from the two byte-term packings; no sliding windows or character repair
C30.oracle: Every complete valid scalar checked against both P2PKH formats; no hash-based finalization
C30.scope: WIF or full target equality are actual validation; arbitrary32bytes being representable as hex is not independent evidence

limitations: Finite exploratory family chosen after seeing the image
Lossless rearrangement does not itself prove a decoder
Negative results concern these exact chains, not all stateful or nonlinear algorithms
No independent derivation of offset10 or all seven lag2 high-bit errors is assumed
